text:
Kaito Sato: Hey all :wave: I'm Kaito, joining Platform (APAC, JST). My laptop ships today. Quick questions: who should I tag for Docker credentials to pull internal images? Also curious if there's a recommended terminal config for macOS devs. And is someone my onboarding buddy? Small quirk: I build synthwave playlists while coding.

Ben Ortiz: Welcome Kaito! :tada: I'm Ben, your buddy for the first month. For Docker creds, open the internal infra-access ticket and tag @IT Helpdesk; they issue short-lived tokens. Terminal: most of us use iTerm2 + zsh with powerlevel10k. I can share my dotfiles.

OnboardingBot: Welcome to Redwood, Kaito Sato! An MDM/MDM invite was sent to kaito.sato@example.com. Please enroll once the laptop arrives. If you don't get the invite, reply here.

IT Helpdesk: Hi Kaito  once you confirm MDM enrollment we can provision the Docker registry token. Steps: enroll device, generate SSH key, upload to https://id.redwood/internal-keys, then open a ticket with subject: "docker-registry-token request" and include employee ID.

Kaito Sato: Thanks! MDM email arrived while I was reading this. One follow-up: do we use a central config for ~/.docker/config.json or personal tokens?

Nina Park: We use per-user short-lived tokens tied to MDM-provisioned keys. No shared credentials. For macOS, enable the Keychain credential helper and set permissions via the portal. If you want, I can share the small script we run to set this up.

Ben Ortiz: Also, if you want a monitor/dock, fill the hardware form: https://redwood.it/hw-request. Shipping usually takes 3-5 business days to JP.

Kaito Sato: Got it. Employee ID is E-55190. MDM enrolled and SSH key uploaded. Thanks everyone. Fun fact: my synthwave playlist has a track called "Late Deploy". :synth:

Clara Liu: Welcome Kaito  excited to have you on Platform. We'll do a team quick intro tomorrow 09:00 JST and a 1:1 on day 3. If any access hiccups, DM me. Also excellent playlist name :grin:

Ben Ortiz: :thumbsup: See you tomorrow, Kaito. I'll drop my dotfiles link and a short iTerm2 prefs export in the thread after lunch.

Kaito Sato: Thanks all, appreciate the speedy help. Looking forward to meeting everyone.
